Its medium- to long-term management vision, 'TECHNO RYOWA 2032', sets out as basic policies: 'growth' through steady growth focused on quality; 'investment' in human capital, research and development, DX and brand; and 'ESG' through contributing to a sustainable society and sustainably improving corporate value. As the first phase of this vision, it is promoting a three-year medium-term business plan with fiscal 2026 as its final year. For the current period, as specific initiatives, it states that it is pursuing a well-balanced order intake centered on industrial facilities, enhancing corporate value through CSR activities, and improving productivity through the promotion of DX.
